node.statement: The hypotheses on A,w,P_j together with epsilon <= W.e1/W.K1 and the witness relations W.c0_cb=c0, W.K1>=K_1^0, W.e1<=e_1 are exactly the instance hypotheses of lem-maincb-stage1-call-envelope. That external, using lem-maincb-stage1-raw-refinement for the Stage-1 sum map, furnishes an explicit Stage-1 raw call at t_1=W.K1*epsilon with literal map u_1:C^{m+1}->A, fixed amplifications, u_1 an extended D_1*t_1-inclusion, and ||u_1(I_{C^{m+1}})-I_A|| <= D_1*t_1, including the stated m=1 interpretation.
